{"consolidated_memory":"## Crash Loop Incidents in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (Infrastructure)

Repeated crash loop problem in deployment with consistent signal (container restarting a few seconds after start), reproduced by rolling out to the small node pool. Stack is YAML; covering check is manifest lint and dry run in CI. Five separate root causes identified and fixed:

**[2026-04-12] Incident #1: Unbounded Retry Loop**
- Trigger: Only affected clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #2636, branch fix/crash-loop-2)
- Result: flaky test rate improved from 80 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Note: Same corner of deployment.yaml as earlier crash loop work, context carried over

**[2026-05-13] Incident #2: Floating Point Rounding**
- Trigger: Only affected accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #2674, branch fix/crash-loop-3)
- Result: backlog cleared 9 minutes after deploy

**[2026-06-20] Incident #3: Stale Cache Entry**
- Trigger: Only appeared on first request after cold start
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #4153, branch fix/crash-loop-5)
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 3 days running

**[2026-07-04] Incident #4: Clock Skew**
- Trigger: Only appeared for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #6501, branch fix/crash-loop-7)
- Result: job finished in 60 minutes instead of 5 hours

**[2026-07-13] Incident #5: Lazy Initialization Race**
- Trigger: Only appeared for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: race in lazy initialization
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #7682, branch fix/crash-loop-8)
- Result: cold start dropped 91 percent, to 752 ms
- Note: Same corner of deployment.yaml as earlier crash loop work, context carried over"}
